gizmo.title: Tchati cha Pai
gizmo.description: Imapanga tchati chopezeka kwa onse chochokera ku CSV.

configure.title: Mutu wa Tchati
configure.description: Mawu ena opezeka kwa onse a tchati chanu.

configure.title: Kufotokozera kwa Tchati
configure.description: Kufotokozera kopezeka kwa onse kwa tchati chanu.

configure.title: Dzina la Muyeso
configure.description: Chiyerekezo cha m'lifupi:kutalika kwa tchati (Onani https://gionkunz.github.io/chartist-js/getting-started.html#default-sass-settings kuti mupeze $ct-scales ndi $ct-scales-names).

configure.title: Zonse
configure.description: Chiwerengero chonse chosankha chomwe mungatchule. Mukatchula chiwerengero chonse, kuphatikiza kwa mitengo ya gulu kuyenera kukhala chiwerengero ichi kuti pai yathunthu ijambulidwe. Mutha kugwiritsa ntchito izi kujambula mbali zina zokha za pai kapena ma tchati a geji.

configure.title: Musanyalanyaze Mitengo Yopanda Kanthu
configure.description: Mitengo yopanda kanthu idzanyalanyazidwa kuti mupewe kujambula magawo ndi zizindikiro zosafunikira.

advanced.title: Tembenuzani Deta
advanced.description: Tembenuzani deta kuphatikizapo zizindikiro, kutsatana kwa magulu komanso magulu onse a deta.

advanced.title: Tebulo la HTML
advanced.description: Chosankha: Tsegulani deta ngati tebulo la HTML.

advanced.title: Donati Yodzaza
advanced.description: Jambulani magawo a donati ngati mawonekedwe m'malo mwa mizere.

advanced.title: Kolowera Chizindikiro
advanced.description: Jambulani magawo a donati ngati mawonekedwe m'malo mwa mizere.

advanced.title: Kusuntha kwa Chizindikiro
advanced.description: Kusuntha kwa malo a chizindikiro kuchokera pa malo okhazikika omwe ndi theka la radius. Mtengo uwu ukhoza kukhala wabwino kapena woipa. Mitengo yabwino idzaika chizindikiro kutali ndi pakati.
